notes.title: Beta Update: Fresh Features Await!
notes.content:
Hey Ritualists,

The beta update for Ritualist is here, and it’s loaded with improvements! Check out what’s new:


Visual&Art: Completely revamped VFX and color palette, polished environments, added currency models and boss visuals that’ll leave you in awe.
Gameplay: A global map is available for navigation, and local maps generate as you enter each stage—no more isolated platforms! Now you can customize and switch weapons in the lobby, unlock abilities through meta-progression, and face smarter enemies with updated AI. Plus, you'll now discover lootable currency drops, and defeating a boss finally lets you complete the game (or at least a chapter).
UI: A sleek, functional update with new icons and tweaks to make your experience smoother.
Technical: A rebuilt animation system for fluid combat and the integration of FMOD audio for richer soundscapes (coming soon!). 


We are counting on you to test these updates and share your feedback. Let’s make Ritualist the best it can be together!

The Ritualist Team
